name: independent-diagnostics
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: A short AUTH_SECRET does not stop startup
steps.actual: With AUTH_SECRET set to a 12-character value the app came up healthy, /readyz answered 200 and the sign-in page answered 200. The only sign of the problem was two log lines: "[better-auth] Warning: your BETTER_AUTH_SECRET should be at least 32 characters long for adequate security" and a low-entropy warning. Restoring the generated key returned the installation to readiness. This is why the guide's key row now separates the missing-key refusal and the OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY floor from a short AUTH_SECRET, which is only a warning.

steps.action: An unreachable database endpoint stops startup and recovers
steps.actual: DATABASE_URL pointing at a host that does not resolve put app and worker into a restart loop with "Error: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND no-such-db" and code ENOTFOUND in the app log, and /readyz was unreachable. Removing the setting and recreating the containers returned /readyz 200.

With the app process still running and its database container stopped, /healthz answered 200 while /readyz answered 503 with {"status":"unavailable"}. Starting the database again returned /readyz 200. This is the state the guide's "/healthz works but /readyz fails" row describes.

steps.action: An unreachable retained storage reader leaves readiness untouched
steps.actual: With S3_ENDPOINT pointed at a name that does not resolve while azure-blob took new writes, /readyz still answered {"status":"ok"} and the download of the Document stored on the S3 driver failed with HTTP 500, while Documents on the local and azure-blob stores downloaded with matching SHA-256 values. Correcting the endpoint restored all three stores. Recorded in full in independent-storage-fault-wrong-endpoint and independent-storage-fault-corrected.

steps.action: A stopped worker leaves an upload pending and resumes it
steps.actual: With the worker stopped the API accepted a new PDF and its Version stayed "pending"; the original file still downloaded byte-identical. Starting the worker again took a new upload to "ready". Recorded in independent-processing-worker-stopped and independent-processing-worker-resumed.

steps.action: An unreachable document engine fails processing while the API stays ready
steps.actual: With DOC_ENGINE_URL pointed at an address that does not answer, a real PDF reached the terminal state "failed" under the normal queue retry timings while /readyz stayed {"status":"ok"}. Removing the override took a new PDF to "ready" with its uploaded words and a byte-identical download. Recorded in independent-processing-engine-failed and independent-processing-engine-recovered.

steps.action: A stranded migration journal refuses startup and both documented diagnostics identify it
steps.actual: Writers were stopped and one recorded bookkeeping hash in this disposable fixture was replaced with a marker value, its exact original hash and stamp kept privately first. The app then refused to start with "This database cannot apply the migrations it is missing." and named 0090_request_triage_assignee (stamped 1788637394684), and /readyz was unreachable. Both read-only commands in the guide worked against the refusing installation: the psql query listed the unrecognized hash at the newest stamp, and docker compose run --rm --no-deps app node scripts/lint-migration-journal.mjs --hashes mapped that stamp to 0090_request_triage_assignee and its true hash. Restoring the exact recorded hash returned /readyz 200. Injecting and undoing this fixture fault is reviewer setup, not a repair procedure the guide offers to readers.

limitations: Every fault was induced on the reviewer's own disposable installation, one at a time, and reversed before the next.
Signing and AI connector diagnostics were not exercised: C42/C43 provider access is still blocked, so those paragraphs of the article remain unverified here.
